Interface Configurable

All Known Subinterfaces:
ConfigurableMatcher, Matcher
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractSubtreeMatcher, AutoMatchers.SimpleGumtreeAuto, AutoMatchers.SimpleGumtreeAutoMt, ChangeDistillerBottomUpMatcher, ChangeDistillerLeavesMatcher, ChangeDistillerParallelLeavesMatcher, CompositeMatchers.ChangeDistiller, CompositeMatchers.ChangeDistillerTheta, CompositeMatchers.ClassicGumtree, CompositeMatchers.ClassicGumtreeTheta, CompositeMatchers.CompositeMatcher, CompositeMatchers.HybridGumtree, CompositeMatchers.HybridIdGumtree, CompositeMatchers.RtedTheta, CompositeMatchers.SimpleGumtree, CompositeMatchers.SimpleGumtreeStable, CompositeMatchers.SimpleIdGumtree, CompositeMatchers.SimpleIdGumtreeTheta, CompositeMatchers.Theta, CompositeMatchers.XyMatcher, CrossMoveMatcherThetaF, GreedyBottomUpMatcher, GreedySubtreeMatcher, HybridBottomUpMatcher, IdenticalSubtreeMatcherThetaA, IdMatcher, InnerNodesMatcherThetaD, LcsMatcher, LcsOptMatcherThetaB, LeafMoveMatcherThetaE, RtedMatcher, SimpleBottomUpMatcher, SimpleMarriageBottomUpMatcher, TopDownMatcher, UnmappedLeavesMatcherThetaC, XyBottomUpMatcher, ZsMatcher
public interface Configurable
Interface for configurable gumtree objects, mainly matchers. Options are furnished via a dedicated GumtreeProperties object as key - values. The list of existing keys is in a dedicated enum.

      default void configure(GumtreeProperties properties)
